fluff.overview: The Arcas is a 65-ton Clan heavy BattleMech introduced in 3061 by Clan Ghost Bear as a symbolic expression of a new era for the Clan following its mass exodus to the Inner Sphere and the establishment of the Ghost Bear Dominion. Named for a figure from ancient Greek mythology who became the constellation Ursa Minor, the Arcas was produced by Bergan Industries on Alshain and conceived as a sophisticated second-line garrison design. Expensive for its intended role, the Arcas nonetheless earned a solid reputation among the Dominion's military as a capable and well-rounded heavy combatant, with production continuing through the Rasalhague Dominion era and into the ilClan period.
fluff.capabilities:
The Arcas is exceptionally mobile for its weight class. A 325-rated XL fusion engine propels the chassis to speeds of 86 kph, comparable to many medium 'Mechs, while five Clan Standard Type A3 jump jets provide a jump capacity of 150 meters. This combination of ground speed and jump capability gives the Arcas tactical flexibility uncommon among heavy BattleMechs, allowing it to exploit terrain and outmaneuver heavier opponents. The reliance on an extralight engine does carry risk, however, as catastrophic damage to either side torso will destroy the engine and disable the 'Mech entirely. Backing up this impressive mobility is thirteen and a half tons of Compound 12A1 standard armor on an endo steel frame, the maximum protection a chassis of its tonnage can carry.

The Arcas carries an array of weaponry effective at all ranges. A pair of Series 7K extended range large lasers mounted in the arms serve as the primary long-range armament, capable of sniping targets or adding firepower to devastating short-range salvos. Two Kolibri Delta Series medium pulse lasers and three Smartshot Mk. V Streak SRM-4 launchers provide lethal close-range firepower, with the Streak technology ensuring no missile is wasted. The design carries only a single ton of missile ammunition, a genuine constraint in prolonged engagements that forces pilots to exercise fire discipline or risk running dry at a critical moment. Fifteen double heat sinks manage the thermal load, though sustained alpha strikes will still generate uncomfortable levels of waste heat.
fluff.history:
The Arcas emerged from a deliberate effort by Clan Ghost Bear leadership to create cultural touchstones marking the Clan's transition to an Inner Sphere power. Following the completion of the mass exodus and the establishment of the Ghost Bear Dominion, Khan Bjorn Jorgensson determined that new symbols were needed to define this era. The first such symbol was a massive bronze sculpture of a Leviathan-class WarShip, designated the Great Work, commissioned in late 3060 from a group of recently passed trothkin and placed on display at Alshain with a dedicated viewing center built around it.

The second symbol was more militant in nature: a new second-line BattleMech built at the Bergan Industries facility on Alshain that also produced the Ursus. Loremaster Laurie Tseng named the design after a figure from ancient Greek mythology who became the constellation Ursa Minor, a reminder of where the Clan had chosen to settle, as the constellation was visible nowhere in Clan space. The Arcas stepped off the production line in 3061 and was quickly battle-tested in Trials of Possession with Clan Wolf for the worlds of Leoben, Skandia, and Radstadt. These early engagements validated the design's combat effectiveness and demonstrated the Ghost Bear Dominion's industrial capacity to produce sophisticated new 'Mechs on Inner Sphere soil.

Produced in fairly large numbers, the Arcas was distributed across the Ghost Bear Dominion's military. All of the Ghost Bears' second-line Galaxies received Arcases, with the largest concentration assigned to the Third Bear Regulars Cluster of Theta Galaxy. The design also attracted attention from beyond the Dominion's borders; the Tenth Garrison Cluster of the Nova Cats' Chi Provisional Galaxy acquired an Arcas through a Trial of Possession, demonstrating the design's desirability among allied Clans.

The Bergan Industries facility on Alshain has continued Arcas production through subsequent eras, with ownership of the factory transitioning from Clan Ghost Bear to the Rasalhague Dominion as the political entity evolved. The factory has maintained active production lines for the design from 3061 through the ilClan era, ensuring a steady supply of this capable second-line heavy 'Mech.
fluff.deployment: The base Arcas configuration was designed as the standard second-line heavy combatant for the Ghost Bear Dominion's garrison Galaxies. Its balanced mix of long-range energy weapons, close-range pulse lasers, and missile systems allows it to engage a wide variety of opponents without relying on a specific tactical niche. This versatility made it well suited to the defensive and patrol operations typical of second-line duty, where garrison forces cannot always predict what threats they will face.
fluff.manufacturer: Bergan Industries - Alshain Weapons(formerly GK&T owned)
